jobs.title: Senior Buyer
jobs.description:
Senior Buyer

Full-Time | Hybrid | Morrisville, NC

Make an Impact at Tecan

Are you passionate about procurement, supply planning, supplier management, and continuous improvement? Join Tecan as a Senior Buyer, where you'll play a key role in ensuring the timely availability of materials, services, and equipment while optimizing cost, quality, inventory, and supplier performance.

In this role, you'll serve as a key procurement partner across Customer Service, Warehouse, Quality, Engineering, Product Management, Accounting, project management, and external suppliers. You'll manage purchasing activities, analyze customer demand, develop stocking and sourcing strategies, and drive improvements throughout the supply chain.

If you're an analytical, collaborative procurement professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment and enjoys managing suppliers, optimizing inventory, and improving supply-chain performance, we'd love to hear from you.

How Will You Make an Impact?

• Procure materials, services, and capital equipment for Tecan U.S.

• Evaluate purchase requisitions to optimize quality, delivery, cost, and availability.

• Serve as the primary Tecan contact for vendors regarding pricing, delivery, performance, and escalations.

• Expedite critical orders and provide status updates to project managers and key stakeholders.

• Initiate and manage supplier and departmental corrective actions as required.

• Lead supplier audits to ensure vendor performance, quality standards, and regulatory compliance.

• Analyze customer demand and trends to develop accurate forecasts and establish appropriate stocking levels and reorder points.

• Develop and implement sourcing strategies and annual sourcing plans to control purchased-material costs and ensure reliable sources of supply.

• Support sourcing strategies aligned with corporate and divisional goals and objectives.

• Collaborate with the broader Tecan organization to evaluate vendor capabilities, terms and conditions, and supplier stability.

• Develop and maintain strong supplier relationships to ensure open communication and efficient working partnerships.

• Build vendor capability awareness across departments to support effective supplier selection.

• Partner with Finance and Accounts Payable to resolve procurement-related invoice discrepancies.

• Maintain procurement procedures, schedules, reports, and KPIs.

• Establish, monitor, and manage vendor KPIs to meet internal performance targets.

• Serve as the SAP Procurement Power User, maintaining data and process integrity.

• Follow all applicable safety procedures and OSHA requirements and report safety concerns.

• Participate in local and global projects as required.

• Support additional business needs and respond positively to changing priorities.

What You Bring

• Customer-service-focused approach with both internal and external stakeholders.

• Strong knowledge of procurement principles, processes, and best practices.

• Excellent organizational and time-management skills.

• Ability to prioritize workload and meet deadlines.

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

• Strong professional phone and email etiquette.

• Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage multiple priorities.

• Strong follow-up and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with diverse internal and external groups.

• Strong business acumen and ability to evaluate the financial impact of procurement decisions.

• Strong negotiation and influencing skills.

• Excellent research, analytical, and decision-making skills.

• Willingness to travel as required, less than 10%.

• A desire to make a meaningful difference.

Your Background

• Bachelor's degree in Business, Engineering, Supply Chain, or equivalent experience.

• 5+ years of progressive procurement experience.

• ERP experience required; SAP preferred .

• Working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

• Experience working with accounting systems.

• Demonstrated experience in procurement, supplier management, sourcing, and purchasing.

• Experience analyzing customer demand, lead times, supplier capacity, and inventory requirements.

• Experience managing supplier performance and procurement KPIs.

• Experience negotiating pricing, delivery, and supplier terms.

• Experience supporting cross-functional supply-chain initiatives.

Nice to Have

• MBA.

• APICS certification.

• Advanced SAP procurement experience.

• Experience leading supplier audits and corrective actions.

• Experience developing and managing supplier performance KPIs.

• Experience with demand forecasting and inventory optimization.

• Experience developing alternate sources of supply or substitute materials.

• Experience leading continuous-improvement initiatives.

• Experience optimizing procurement costs and supply-chain processes.

Salary Range: 80K-110K

Compensation will be determined based on education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities, internal equity, and applicable market data.

jobs.title: Field Sales Engineer, Liquid Handling
jobs.description:
Ever wonder how your unique background could impact the world of tomorrow?  Join our Sales Engineering team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Field Sales Engineer

Southeast (TN, FL, GA, MS, AL, LA)
Full-Time | Exempt

Make an Impact at Tecan

Are you passionate about enabling scientific discovery through advanced laboratory automation and liquid handling technologies? Join our team as a  Sales Engineer, Liquid Handling , where you will play a critical role in driving growth across the Southeast territory.

In this role, you will be responsible for selling Tecan’s liquid handling portfolio — including capital equipment, reagents, consumables, and service contracts — while partnering closely with customers in life sciences, biotech, academic, and government research environments. You will act as a trusted advisor, helping customers translate complex application needs into innovative automation solutions.

If you are a consultative sales professional with a strong technical background in laboratory automation and a passion for customer success, we invite you to bring your expertise to our team.

How Will You Make an Impact?

• Manage the full sales cycle including prospecting, lead generation, qualification, demonstrations, proposals, negotiations, closing, installation coordination, and post-sale support
• Achieve or exceed assigned sales, growth, and financial targets for the Southeast territory
• Develop and execute strategic account plans to grow new and existing business• Serve as a trusted technical advisor, translating customer workflows into tailored liquid handling solutions
• Conduct product demonstrations and workflow-based presentations for scientific and procurement stakeholders
• Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, including researchers, lab managers, and procurement teams
• Maintain accurate forecasting and CRM data to support business planning
• Support installations, training, and ongoing customer adoption of Tecan solutions
• Partner with Service, Applications, and Technical Support teams to ensure customer satisfaction
• Participate in regional and national trade shows, conferences, and customer events
• Identify and communicate market trends, competitive activity, and new application opportunities
• Collaborate with internal teams to resolve customer issues and ensure long-term account success
• Ensure compliance with all regulatory, company, and safety requirements
• Travel within the assigned territory as required,  up to 50% overnight travel , including short-notice travel when necessary

What You Bring

• Strong ability to manage and grow a technical sales territory in a capital equipment environment
• Deep understanding of consultative and solution-based selling approaches
• Excellent communication skills with ability to present technical and non-technical concepts clearly• Strong presentation and customer-facing skills with scientific and procurement audiences
• Proven ability to manage complex sales cycles and multiple stakeholders
• Strong organizational and time management skills with attention to detail
• Ability to work independently in a remote, field-based role
• High level of adaptability, initiative, and problem-solving ability
• Strong collaboration skills with internal teams and external partners
• Ability to work well under pressure and manage competing priorities

Your Background

• Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or related field required
• 3+ years of sales experience in capital equipment within the life sciences industry
• Experience with liquid handling systems, laboratory automation, or microplate instrumentation strongly preferred• Demonstrated success in territory management and technical sales environments
• Strong proficiency with CRM systems and Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
• Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel regularly

Nice to Have

• Experience in laboratory automation or high-throughput screening environments
• Familiarity with academic, biotech, or government research markets
• Experience supporting product demonstrations and on-site customer training• Background working with procurement and institutional purchasing processes
• Experience with trade shows, scientific conferences, or field marketing support
• Strong analytical or data-driven sales forecasting skills

What We Offer

• Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
• 401(k) employer match on first 6% contributions (no vesting period)
• Company-paid Life Insurance'

• Short- and Long-Term Disability coverage
• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
• Accident, Critical Illness & Hospital Indemnity insurance
• Legal Shield / Identity Shield
• Discounted Pet Insurance

Salary range: $100K– $125K
(Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with industry data.)

jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Are you passionate about strategic marketing, cross-functional collaboration, and making a real impact in a global organization? Tecan, a publicly listed leader in life sciences, is seeking a Marketing Trainee for our Partnering Business Division to drive brand awareness, generate demand, and support sales through innovative marketing initiatives. Join our Marketing Department in Partnering Business and bring your creativity, analytical mindset, and customer-centric approach to work.

Trainee in Marketing – Fix-Term, 6 months (100%)

Männedorf, Zurich

Your contribution
 In this exciting and hands-on role, you will have the opportunity to:

• Support integrated and account-based marketing (ABM) initiatives to engage targeted customers and generate qualified leads

• Assist in setting up, monitoring, and optimizing digital marketing campaigns

• Coordinate campaign assets such as emails, landing pages, digital ads, and webinars, ensuring consistency across touch points

• Track, analyze and report campaign performance, ensuring alignment with key performance indicators (KPIs)

• Contribute to the development of marketing dashboards and reporting tools to visualize performance metrics and insights

• Maintain and improve CRM data quality for accurate segmentation and lead tracking

• Contribute to brand awareness activities, including digital content creation, market insights and competitor research

• Support marketing-related events and internal communication activities

• Collaborate closely with Product Management, Sales, Digital Marketing, and Branding teams

Your background
 We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Currently studying towards a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in business administration, Marketing, Data Science, or Information Systems

• 0-2 years of relevant experience (internships or professional experience), ideally at least one completed internship

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office (especially Excel and PowerPoint)

• Familiarity with CRM and marketing automation tools (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot or similar)

• Experience with KPI dashboards or data visualization tools is a plus

• Excellent communication skills in English (German is a plus)

• A strong analytical mindset and genuine interest in data-driven marketing

• A detail-oriented, proactive, and collaborative working style

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

• You can expect a collegial and supportive team culture built on openness and trust.

• The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The opportunity to grow your career in a company that values both excellence and business impact.

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique Tecan culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We look forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (without picture and without cover letter; reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Only applications that fully meet our requirements will be considered.

You will manage self-directed planning activities, resolve material shortages and gaps, expedite materials when necessary, and occasionally execute purchase orders to close supply gaps.

In this customer-focused role, strong communication and relationship-building skills will be critical to your success. You will use material analytics to confirm availability, identify risks, and proactively support on-time production. Your ability to analyze data, make sound decisions, and collaborate with internal teams and customers will directly contribute to meeting production and customer commitments.

How Will You Make an Impact?

• Analyze material requirements and kit demand for the upcoming 12–26 weeks.

• Plan and commit kits based on material availability for assigned customers.

• Identify material gaps that may prevent achievement of targeted kit drop dates.

• Develop mitigation plans and escalate material issues that may jeopardize production or revenue.

• Manage the purchase of customer-provided parts and materials as required.

• Partner with Program Managers to ensure alignment between Tecan and customer requirements.

• Provide customers with weekly excess material approval requests.

• Follow the established workflow to obtain customer approvals and close excess material issues within the required timeframe.

• Prepare and analyze the monthly Excess Resolution Report using Spotlight, including zero-demand and excess inventory with demand.

• Validate material data, identify changes or discrepancies, and provide recommendations as needed.

• Coordinate sales order entry for approved excess inventory sales.

• Coordinate shipment of excess materials to customers.

• Work with customers to coordinate purchase order changes resulting from final quantity variances.

• Monitor buyer pull-in actions to ensure identified material gaps are resolved.

• Run What-If analyses to support customer pull-in and push-out requests.

• Perform material impact analysis and disposition activities associated with Engineering Change Orders (ECOs).

• Conduct quarterly Bill of Materials (BOM) profile analyses to identify sole-sourced components, long-lead-time materials, risk buys, and potential obsolescence as part of the Material Mitigation Program.

What You Bring

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to evaluate complex material issues and develop practical solutions.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong customer service and relationship-building skills.

• Highly detail-oriented with strong organizational and prioritization skills.

• Ability to work independently, manage self-directed tasks, and follow issues through to resolution.

• Strong decision-making skills and demonstrated follow-through.

• Ability to communicate material risks clearly and escalate issues appropriately.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with customers, buyers, Program Managers, and internal stakeholders.

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment while managing competing priorities.

Your Background

• The experience, education, and technical qualifications required for the role.

• 5–7 years of experience in materials planning, supply chain, or a related field.

• Experience with direct material purchasing or procurement.

• Advanced Excel skills for reporting, data analysis, and scenario modeling.

• Experience in a customer-facing supply chain role.

• Experience with BOM analysis, shortage management, excess inventory resolution, and material risk mitigation.

• Experience performing material impact analysis related to Engineering Change Orders (ECOs).

• Experience working in a manufacturing or production environment.

• Experience using ERP/MRP systems.

• Intermediate-level Excel skills for reporting and data analysis.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications.

Nice to Have

• Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Operations, or a related field.

• APICS or NAPM certification.

• Experience with Manex and Spotlight software.

What We Offer

• Medical, Dental, and Vision effective on your first day

• 16 company-paid holidays

• 401(k) employer match on first 6% contributions (no vesting period)

• Company-paid Life Insurance

• HSA & HRA options

• Company-paid short- and long-term disability

• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

• Accident, Critical Illness & Hospital Indemnity coverage

• Legal Shield / Identity Shield

• Discounted Pet Insurance

Salary range: $100k– $120K
(Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with industry data.)

What makes working at Tecan unique?

• The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

Machen Sie einen Impact bei Tecan

Als Materialplaner sind Sie ein integraler Bestandteil unseres kundenorientierten Supply Chain-Teams und stellen sicher, dass die für die Produktion benötigten Materialien bei Bedarf verfügbar sind. Sie verwalten selbstgesteuerte Planungsaktivitäten, beheben Materialmangel und -lücken, beschleunigen bei Bedarf Materialien und führen gelegentlich Bestellungen aus, um Versorgungslücken zu schließen.

In dieser kundenorientierten Rolle sind starke Kommunikations- und Beziehungsaufbaufähigkeiten entscheidend für Ihren Erfolg. Sie werden Materialanalysen verwenden, um die Verfügbarkeit zu bestätigen, Risiken zu identifizieren und die termingerechte Produktion proaktiv zu unterstützen. Ihre Fähigkeit, Daten zu analysieren, fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen und mit internen Teams und Kunden zusammenzuarbeiten, trägt direkt zur Erfüllung von Produktions- und Kundenverpflichtungen bei.

Wie werden Sie eine Wirkung erzielen?

• Analysieren Sie den Materialbedarf und den Kit-Nachfrage für die kommenden 12-26 Wochen.

• Planen und Commit-Kits basierend auf Materialverfügbarkeit für zugewiesene Kunden.

• Bereiten und analysieren Sie den monatlichen Excess Resolution Report mit Spotlight, einschließlich Null-Nachfrage und überschüssigen Inventar mit Nachfrage.

• Koordinieren Sie den Versand von überschüssigem Material an die Kunden.

• Überwachen Sie Käufer-Pull-In-Aktionen, um sicherzustellen, dass identifizierte Materiallücken behoben werden.

• Führen Sie What-If-Analysen aus, um Kunden-Pull-In- und Push-Out-Anfragen zu unterstützen.

• Führen Sie Materialfolgenanalysen und Dispositionsaktivitäten im Zusammenhang mit Engineering Change Orders (ECOs) durch.

• Führen Sie vierteljährliche Profilanalysen der Stückliste (BOM) durch, um Einzelkomponenten, Materialien mit langer Vorlaufzeit, Risikokäufe und mögliche Obsoleszenz im Rahmen des Materialminderungsprogramms zu identifizieren.

jobs.title: Field Service Application Specialist
jobs.description:
Field Service Applications Specialist

Field-Based | Full-Time

Florida - VA Region | Up to 50% Travel

Make an Impact With Our Team

Are you passionate about laboratory automation, scientific applications, and helping customers maximize the value of their liquid handling systems? We are seeking a Field Service Applications Specialist (FSAS) to serve as the post-sale technical expert supporting Liquid Handling automation platforms throughout the Americas.

In this role, you will partner closely with Field Automation Engineers, Application Scientists, Product Management, and customers to deliver application-based automation solutions that integrate software, hardware, and biological workflows. You will provide advanced technical expertise throughout the customer lifecycle, including application development, installation support, troubleshooting, training, and workflow optimization.

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, working directly with customers, and supporting innovative laboratory automation technologies, we encourage you to apply.

How Will You Make an Impact?

• Become a technical expert in Liquid Handling automation, providing advanced application support throughout the customer lifecycle.

• Support both pre-sale and post-sale activities by evaluating customer applications and recommending automation solutions.

• Design, configure, and implement application-based solutions using software, scripting, hardware, and laboratory workflows.

• Collaborate with Field Automation Engineers to shift customer discussions from product features toward application-driven solutions.

• Provide application analysis, workflow configuration, instrument demonstrations, installation support, and advanced troubleshooting.

• Deliver technical training and application support to Field Automation Engineers and members of the service organization.

• Partner with Product Management and Applications teams to communicate customer feedback and field requirements.

• Serve as the primary technical resource for complex application issues involving liquid handling automation platforms.

• Assist customers with programming, workflow optimization, and application-specific problem resolution.

• Maintain awareness of emerging scientific technologies, laboratory workflows, and automation trends.

• Travel extensively throughout the Americas and internationally as needed to support customer installations, training, and service activities.

• Ensure compliance with company quality systems, safety policies, and regulatory requirements.

• Complete assigned projects while maintaining high standards for documentation, communication, and customer satisfaction.

What You Bring

• Strong customer-focused communication and relationship-building skills.

• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation abilities.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced technical environment.

• Excellent organizational and time management skills.

• Ability to conceptualize and develop application-based automation solutions.

• Strong follow-up skills and attention to detail.

• Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across technical and commercial teams.

• High level of initiative, accountability, and professionalism.

• Ability to thrive under pressure while maintaining exceptional customer service.

• Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with scientific literature and emerging technologies.

• Willingness and ability to travel up to 50%, including regional and international travel.

Your Background

• Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biology, Computer Science, or a related scientific discipline.

• Minimum of two years of experience with laboratory automation or liquid handling systems in academic or industry environments.

• Experience developing automation applications using native instrument software or programming languages.

• Hands-on experience with automated laboratory instrumentation.

• Knowledge of molecular biology workflows including:

• Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) sample preparation

• PCR and qPCR setup

• Nucleic acid purification

• DNA/RNA quantification and normalization

• Experience supporting customers in technical or scientific environments.

• Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Windows applications.

Nice to Have

• Experience with VBScript, VBA, and .NET programming.

• Experience designing and implementing laboratory automation workflows.

• Background supporting Field Service Engineers or Application Scientists.

• Experience delivering customer training and technical presentations.

• Knowledge of liquid handling programming, scripting, and workflow optimization.

• Familiarity with third-party laboratory instruments and reagent integration.

• Experience collaborating with Product Management and cross-functional technical teams.

What We Offer

• Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.

• Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance.

• 401(k) with company match.

• Paid time off and company holidays.

• Professional development and technical training opportunities.

• Career growth within a global leader in laboratory automation.

• Collaborative and innovative team environment.

• Opportunity to support cutting-edge technologies advancing life science research worldwide.

Salary range: $100K– $125K
(Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with industry data.)

descriptionByLocale.it:
Specialista di applicazioni di servizio sul campo

Field-Based | Full-Time

Florida - VA Region | Fino al 50% Viaggi

Fare un impatto con il nostro team

Sei appassionato di automazione di laboratorio, applicazioni scientifiche e di aiutare i clienti a massimizzare il valore dei loro sistemi di gestione dei liquidi? Stiamo cercando un Field Service Applications Specialist (FSAS) per servire come esperto tecnico post-vendita che supporta piattaforme di automazione Liquid Handling in tutte le Americhe.

In questo ruolo, partnerrai a stretto contatto con gli ingegneri di automazione di campo, gli scienziati delle applicazioni, la gestione dei prodotti e i clienti per fornire soluzioni di automazione basate sulle applicazioni che integrano software, hardware e flussi di lavoro biologici. Fornirai competenze tecniche avanzate durante il ciclo di vita del cliente, tra cui sviluppo delle applicazioni, supporto di installazione, risoluzione dei problemi, formazione e ottimizzazione del flusso di lavoro.

Se ti piace risolvere complesse sfide tecniche, lavorare direttamente con i clienti e supportare tecnologie di automazione di laboratorio innovative, ti invitiamo a applicare.

Come farai ad avere un impatto?

• Diventa un esperto tecnico nell'automazione Liquid Handling, fornendo un supporto avanzato all'applicazione durante il ciclo di vita del cliente.

• Supporta sia le attività pre-vendita che post-vendita valutando le applicazioni dei clienti e raccomandando soluzioni di automazione.

• Progettare, configurare e implementare soluzioni basate su applicazioni utilizzando software, scripting, hardware e flussi di lavoro di laboratorio.

• Collabora con gli ingegneri di automazione del campo per spostare le discussioni dei clienti dalle caratteristiche del prodotto verso le soluzioni basate sulle applicazioni.

• Fornire analisi delle applicazioni, configurazione del flusso di lavoro, dimostrazioni degli strumenti, supporto di installazione e risoluzione avanzata dei problemi.

• Fornire formazione tecnica e supporto alle applicazioni a Field Automation Engineers e membri dell'organizzazione di servizio.

• Partner con i team di Product Management e Applications per comunicare i requisiti di feedback e campo dei clienti.

• Servire come risorsa tecnica primaria per problemi di applicazione complessi che coinvolgono piattaforme di automazione di gestione liquida.

• Assistere i clienti con programmazione, ottimizzazione dei flussi di lavoro e risoluzione dei problemi specifici delle applicazioni.

• Mantenere la consapevolezza delle tecnologie scientifiche emergenti, dei flussi di lavoro di laboratorio e delle tendenze di automazione.

• Viaggia in tutta l'America e a livello internazionale come necessario per supportare le installazioni dei clienti, la formazione e le attività di servizio.

• Assicurare il rispetto dei sistemi di qualità aziendale, politiche di sicurezza e requisiti normativi.

• Progetti assegnati completi mantenendo elevati standard per la documentazione, la comunicazione e la soddisfazione del cliente.

Che cosa porta

• Forte comunicazione focalizzata sul cliente e capacità di costruzione di relazioni.

• Eccellente capacità scritte, verbali e di presentazione.

• Forte pensiero analitico e capacità di problem solving.

• Capacità di gestire più priorità in un ambiente tecnico veloce.

• Eccellente capacità organizzative e di gestione del tempo.

• Capacità di concettualizzare e sviluppare soluzioni di automazione basate sulle applicazioni.

• Forte capacità di follow-up e attenzione ai dettagli.

• Mindset collaborativo con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente in team tecnici e commerciali.

• Alto livello di iniziativa, responsabilità e professionalità.

• Capacità di prosperare sotto pressione mantenendo un servizio clienti eccezionale.

• Impegno all'apprendimento continuo e alla corrente con la letteratura scientifica e le tecnologie emergenti.

• Volontà e capacità di viaggiare fino al 50%, compresi i viaggi regionali e internazionali.

Il tuo sfondo

• Laurea in ingegneria biomedica, biologia, informatica, o una disciplina scientifica correlata.

• Minimo di due anni di esperienza con sistemi di automazione di laboratorio o di manipolazione liquida in ambienti accademici o industriali.

• Esperienza di sviluppo applicazioni di automazione utilizzando software di strumenti nativi o linguaggi di programmazione.

• Esperienza pratica con strumentazione di laboratorio automatizzata.

• Conoscenza dei flussi di lavoro di biologia molecolare tra cui:

• Preparazione del campione di prossima generazione (NGS)

• Configurazione PCR e qPCR

• purificazione dell'acido nucleico

• quantificazione del DNA/RNA e normalizzazione

• Esperienza di supporto ai clienti in ambienti tecnici o scientifici.

• Forte conoscenza di funzionamento delle applicazioni Microsoft Windows.

Bello da avere

• Esperienza con la programmazione VBScript, VBA e .NET.

• Progettazione e realizzazione di flussi di lavoro di automazione di laboratorio.

• Background che supporta gli ingegneri del servizio di campo o gli scienziati dell'applicazione.

• Esperienza che offre formazione clienti e presentazioni tecniche.

• Conoscenza della programmazione, scrittura e ottimizzazione del flusso di lavoro.

• Familiarità con strumenti di laboratorio di terze parti e integrazione reagente.

• Esperienza di collaborazione con Product Management e team tecnici interfunzionali.

Cosa offriamo

• Compensazione competitiva e pacchetto completo di benefici.

• Assicurazione medica, dentale e visione.

• 401(k) con fiammifero aziendale.

• Tempo pagato e vacanze aziendali.

• Sviluppo professionale e opportunità di formazione tecnica.

• Crescita di carriera all'interno di un leader globale nell'automazione di laboratorio.

• Ambiente di team collaborativo e innovativo.

• Opportunità di sostenere tecnologie all'avanguardia che promuovano la ricerca sulla scienza della vita in tutto il mondo.

Gamma di insalata: $100K– $125K
(Salario da determinare per l'istruzione, l'esperienza, la conoscenza, le competenze e le capacità del richiedente, l'equità interna e l'allineamento con i dati del settore.)

Are you passionate about laboratory automation, scientific applications, and helping customers maximize the value of their liquid handling systems? We are seeking a Field Service Applications Specialist (FSAS) to serve as the post-sale technical expert supporting Liquid Handling automation platforms throughout the Americas.

In this role, you will partner closely with Field Automation Engineers, Application Scientists, Product Management, and customers to deliver application-based automation solutions that integrate software, hardware, and biological workflows. You will provide advanced technical expertise throughout the customer lifecycle, including application development, installation support, troubleshooting, training, and workflow optimization.

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, working directly with customers, and supporting innovative laboratory automation technologies, we encourage you to apply.

How Will You Make an Impact?

• Become a technical expert in Liquid Handling automation, providing advanced application support throughout the customer lifecycle.

• Support both pre-sale and post-sale activities by evaluating customer applications and recommending automation solutions.

• Design, configure, and implement application-based solutions using software, scripting, hardware, and laboratory workflows.

• Collaborate with Field Automation Engineers to shift customer discussions from product features toward application-driven solutions.

• Provide application analysis, workflow configuration, instrument demonstrations, installation support, and advanced troubleshooting.

• Deliver technical training and application support to Field Automation Engineers and members of the service organization.

• Partner with Product Management and Applications teams to communicate customer feedback and field requirements.

• Serve as the primary technical resource for complex application issues involving liquid handling automation platforms.

• Assist customers with programming, workflow optimization, and application-specific problem resolution.

• Maintain awareness of emerging scientific technologies, laboratory workflows, and automation trends.

• Travel extensively throughout the Americas and internationally as needed to support customer installations, training, and service activities.

• Ensure compliance with company quality systems, safety policies, and regulatory requirements.

• Complete assigned projects while maintaining high standards for documentation, communication, and customer satisfaction.

What You Bring

• Strong customer-focused communication and relationship-building skills.

• Excellent written, verbal, and presentation abilities.

• Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced technical environment.

• Excellent organizational and time management skills.

• Ability to conceptualize and develop application-based automation solutions.

• Strong follow-up skills and attention to detail.

• Collaborative mindset with the ability to work effectively across technical and commercial teams.

• High level of initiative, accountability, and professionalism.

• Ability to thrive under pressure while maintaining exceptional customer service.

• Commitment to continuous learning and staying current with scientific literature and emerging technologies.

• Willingness and ability to travel up to 50%, including regional and international travel.

Your Background

• Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Biology, Computer Science, or a related scientific discipline.

• Minimum of two years of experience with laboratory automation or liquid handling systems in academic or industry environments.

• Experience developing automation applications using native instrument software or programming languages.

• Hands-on experience with automated laboratory instrumentation.

• Knowledge of molecular biology workflows including:

• Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS) sample preparation

• PCR and qPCR setup

• Nucleic acid purification

• DNA/RNA quantification and normalization

• Experience supporting customers in technical or scientific environments.

• Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Windows applications.

Nice to Have

• Experience with VBScript, VBA, and .NET programming.

• Experience designing and implementing laboratory automation workflows.

• Background supporting Field Service Engineers or Application Scientists.

• Experience delivering customer training and technical presentations.

• Knowledge of liquid handling programming, scripting, and workflow optimization.

• Familiarity with third-party laboratory instruments and reagent integration.

• Experience collaborating with Product Management and cross-functional technical teams.

What We Offer

• Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.

• Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance.

• 401(k) with company match.

• Paid time off and company holidays.

• Professional development and technical training opportunities.

• Career growth within a global leader in laboratory automation.

• Collaborative and innovative team environment.

• Opportunity to support cutting-edge technologies advancing life science research worldwide.

Salary range: $100K– $125K
(Salary to be determined by the education, experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities of the applicant, internal equity, and alignment with industry data.)

Floride - région de VA

Ce que vous apportez

• Forte capacité de communication et d'établissement de relations axée sur le client.

• Excellente capacité écrite, verbale et de présentation.

• Forte capacité de réflexion analytique et de résolution de problèmes.

• Capacité de gérer plusieurs priorités dans un environnement technique rapide.

• Excellentes compétences en gestion organisationnelle et temporelle.

• Capacité de conceptualiser et de développer des solutions d'automatisation basées sur l'application.

• Fortes compétences de suivi et attention aux détails.

• L'esprit de collaboration avec la capacité de travailler efficacement entre les équipes techniques et commerciales.

• Capacité de prospérer sous pression tout en maintenant un service à la clientèle exceptionnel.

• Baccalauréat en génie biomédical, en biologie, en informatique ou dans une discipline scientifique connexe.

• Minimum de deux ans d'expérience dans l'automatisation de laboratoire ou les systèmes de traitement des liquides dans des environnements universitaires ou industriels.

• Expérience de développement d'applications d'automatisation utilisant des logiciels d'instruments natifs ou des langages de programmation.

• Expérience pratique avec des instruments de laboratoire automatisés.

• Préparation de l'échantillon du séquençage de la prochaine génération

• Configuration PCR et qPCR

• purification de l'acide nucléique

• Quantification et normalisation de l'ADN/ARN

• Expérience de soutien aux clients dans des environnements techniques ou scientifiques.

• Forte connaissance de travail des applications Microsoft Windows.

Sympa d'avoir

• Expérience de la conception et de la mise en oeuvre de workflows d'automatisation de laboratoire.

• Contexte appuyant les ingénieurs du Service mobile ou les spécialistes des applications.

• Expérience de la formation des clients et des présentations techniques.

• Connaissance de la programmation, du script et de l'optimisation des flux de travail.

• Familiarité avec les instruments de laboratoire tiers et intégration de réactif.

• Expérience en collaboration avec la gestion des produits et des équipes techniques interfonctionnelles.

Ce que nous offrons

jobs.title: Field Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Ever wonder how your unique background could impact the world of tomorrow?  Join our Sales Engineering team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Field Sales Engineer

Boston, MA
Full-Time | Exempt

Make an Impact at Tecan

Are you passionate about enabling scientific discovery through advanced laboratory automation and liquid handling technologies? Join our team as a  Sales Engineer, Liquid Handling , where you will play a critical role in driving growth across the Northeast territory.

In this role, you will be responsible for selling Tecan’s liquid handling portfolio — including capital equipment, reagents, consumables, and service contracts — while partnering closely with customers in life sciences, biotech, academic, and government research environments. You will act as a trusted advisor, helping customers translate complex application needs into innovative automation solutions.

If you are a consultative sales professional with a strong technical background in laboratory automation and a passion for customer success, we invite you to bring your expertise to our team.

How Will You Make an Impact?

• Manage the full sales cycle including prospecting, lead generation, qualification, demonstrations, proposals, negotiations, closing, installation coordination, and post-sale support
• Achieve or exceed assigned sales, growth, and financial targets for the Midwest territory
• Develop and execute strategic account plans to grow new and existing business• Serve as a trusted technical advisor, translating customer workflows into tailored liquid handling solutions
• Conduct product demonstrations and workflow-based presentations for scientific and procurement stakeholders
• Build and maintain strong relationships with customers, including researchers, lab managers, and procurement teams
• Maintain accurate forecasting and CRM data to support business planning
• Support installations, training, and ongoing customer adoption of Tecan solutions
• Partner with Service, Applications, and Technical Support teams to ensure customer satisfaction
• Participate in regional and national trade shows, conferences, and customer events
• Identify and communicate market trends, competitive activity, and new application opportunities
• Collaborate with internal teams to resolve customer issues and ensure long-term account success
• Ensure compliance with all regulatory, company, and safety requirements
• Travel within the assigned territory as required,  up to 50% overnight travel , including short-notice travel when necessary

What You Bring

• Strong ability to manage and grow a technical sales territory in a capital equipment environment
• Deep understanding of consultative and solution-based selling approaches
• Excellent communication skills with ability to present technical and non-technical concepts clearly• Strong presentation and customer-facing skills with scientific and procurement audiences
• Proven ability to manage complex sales cycles and multiple stakeholders
• Strong organizational and time management skills with attention to detail
• Ability to work independently in a remote, field-based role
• High level of adaptability, initiative, and problem-solving ability
• Strong collaboration skills with internal teams and external partners
• Ability to work well under pressure and manage competing priorities

Your Background

• Bachelor’s degree in Life Sciences or related field required
• 3+ years of sales experience in capital equipment within the life sciences industry
• Experience with liquid handling systems, laboratory automation, or microplate instrumentation strongly preferred• Demonstrated success in territory management and technical sales environments
• Strong proficiency with CRM systems and Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
• Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel regularly

Nice to Have

• Experience in laboratory automation or high-throughput screening environments
• Familiarity with academic, biotech, or government research markets
• Experience supporting product demonstrations and on-site customer training• Background working with procurement and institutional purchasing processes
• Experience with trade shows, scientific conferences, or field marketing support
• Strong analytical or data-driven sales forecasting skills

What We Offer

• Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage
• 401(k) employer match on first 6% contributions (no vesting period)
• Company-paid Life Insurance• HSA & HRA options
• Short- and Long-Term Disability coverage
• Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
• Accident, Critical Illness & Hospital Indemnity insurance
• Legal Shield / Identity Shield
• Discounted Pet Insurance
• Opportunities for career growth in a global life sciences organization

Vi siete mai chiesti come le vostre abilità e background unico possono influenzare il mondo di domani? Diventa parte dei nostri team operativi e usa il talento e la passione che ti fanno.

Editor tecnico (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zurigo

Il tuo contributo

In questo ruolo impegnativo e importante, siete responsabili della creazione, gestione e manutenzione dei documenti tecnici per i prodotti fabbricati a Tecan per gli utenti finali, i servizi e i dipendenti di produzione.

• Creazione di documenti utente (principalmente in inglese) come manuali operativi, di servizio e software

• Preparazione di istruzioni di montaggio e istruzioni di prova per la fabbricazione di prodotti

• Creazione e manutenzione dei contenuti orientati al target nel CMS basato su XML (Schema ST4) e nell'applicazione DTP (Adobe FrameMaker)

• Compliance e implementazione dei requisiti normativi

• Attuazione dei contenuti rilevanti per la documentazione dall'analisi del rischio

• Fotografia del prodotto e elaborazione delle immagini

• Creazione di illustrazioni tecniche da dati 2D e 3D

• Creazione o redazione di testi in inglese e tedesco

• Coordinamento dei lavori di traduzione e gestione della terminologia

Il tuo profilo

Stiamo cercando persone che implementano la loro passione e il loro talento con noi.

• Sei una persona esperto di lingua e esatto e divertiti ad aggiornare / creare diverse istruzioni.

• Hai diversi anni di esperienza professionale come editore tecnico o una laurea in editing tecnico, tra cui esperienza professionale.

• Hai una buona conoscenza dei comuni strumenti di editing DTP, illustrazione e immagine (FrameMaker, Photoshop, Illustrator).

• Hai una buona conoscenza dello schema ST4.

• Hai una buona conoscenza del software di illustrazione 3D (Creo Illustrate, 3DViaComposer o software simile).

• Hai ottime competenze in tedesco (C1 min.) e inglese in parola e scrittura.

• È possibile coinvolgere altri per arrivare alle informazioni necessarie.

• È possibile filtrare le informazioni pertinenti e preparare la documentazione specifica del gruppo target che soddisfa i requisiti normativi e specifici dell'azienda.

Cosa rende il lavoro a Tecan unico?

• L'opportunità di fare la differenza e modellare il mondo di domani

• Lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e diversificato

• Eccitanti opportunità di carriera

• Cultura aziendale forte e unica

• Retribuzioni e prestazioni attraenti

Diventa parte di Tecan, certificato come Grande Luogo di Lavoro! Qui potete scoprire di più sulla nostra certificazione. Ottimo posto per lavorare.

Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione online. Per la vostra applicazione, abbiamo solo bisogno del vostro CV (senza foto e senza lettere di motivazione, certificati e diplomi sono facoltativi).

Possiamo solo considerare le applicazioni che soddisfano le nostre esigenze.

#lifescience #healthcare #automation #medicaldevice #biology #biotechnology #tecnica documentazione #product documentazione #illustrations #technical editor #translation management

Il nostro scopo.

A Tecan siamo spinti a migliorare la vita e la salute delle persone. Lo facciamo dando ai nostri clienti la possibilità di scalare l'innovazione sanitaria a livello globale dalla scienza della vita alla clinica. Collaboriamo con i nostri clienti dall'innovazione del primo stadio attraverso l'implementazione del progetto e oltre. Forniamo prodotti, servizi e soluzioni che rendono i processi di laboratorio e le procedure mediche precise, riproducibili e conformi.

Rimanete unici e fatelo contare.

I nostri valori - fiducia, elevati standard e ambizione - sono le basi della nostra attività e forniscono il quadro per la cultura di Tecan. Promuoviamo un ambiente positivo e potente in cui i nostri beni più rari, i nostri dipendenti unici, possono crescere e portare la loro passione e talento al lavoro.

jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Partnering Business department and bring your passion and talent to work.

Senior Manager Key Account Products (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

As a Senior Manager Key Account Products, you are responsible to manage and oversee all business operations related to Key Account OEM customer products of Tecan’s IVD & Life Sciences Partnering Business. You will be the main contact person for key account customer(s) in day-to-day operations, from late-stage development to market launch readiness, managing the product life cycle during multi-year supply phase until end of life/ next generation solution development. Your responsibilities lie in managing the key account partners systems products ensuring product success through quality and supply performance as well as market growth by driving innovation in existing products and/or development of follow-on products. You are the key liaison for the customers to internal counterparts in R&D, Operations, Service, Quality and Regulatory. With your strong customer focus, communication skills and business acumen, you drive customer satisfaction, build long-lasting business partnerships and drive business growth with key accounts.

Responsibilities

• Act as central point of contact for Key Account customers for all day-to-day operational aspects regarding their Systems products, represent the client interests from development to end of life in internal teams

• Oversee operational life cycle management of existing products, ensuring customer satisfaction, compliance, documentation, and financial performance in close collaboration with the dedicated Sales counterpart

• Lead key client meetings like quarterly business reviews, quality reviews as well as internal product care meetings, steering meetings, with regular attendance of executives

• Guide customers through design and regulatory changes and global or local events impacting their business (e.g. tariffs)

• Maintain and manage budget, sales, and forecasts for assigned accounts, ensuring adherence to contract terms in collaboration with Sales

• Oversee product profitability and drive improvement measures with stakeholders

• Lead Product Care Team for assigned products and product families, defining and monitoring critical KPIs, regularly reporting to customers and Tecan management

• Implement corrective measures when KPIs deviate from targets, leading cross-functional teams to ensure success

• Apply your business mindset and client & market understanding to grow the partnership through driving innovation in existing products and/or development of follow-on products that align with the client’s needs

• Provide cross-functional guidance and support for the teams, and continuously seek improvements to Tecan processes

• Champion diversity, equity, and inclusion within the team and broader organization.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Degree in Chemistry, Biology, Medicine, or Engineering; further education in Product Management, Project Management or Business Administration

• Experience in liquid handling and robotics, clinical diagnostics, and/or life sciences

• 5+ years’ experience in highly complex system development, supporting system sales activities, and/or product/lifecycle management

• Experience working with customers/partners in a B2B setting, OEM experience is a plus

• Experience managing cross-functional teams and/or complex products (HW, SW, services)

• Expertise in negotiating complex contracts, particularly in development and supply agreements is a plus

• Proficiency in English; German would be an asset.

• High natural authority, power of persuasion, and ability to handle rapidly changing market and customer situations

• Strong communication skills, experience in communication to executives is a plus

• Team-oriented, customer-focused, persistent, reliable, and self-motivated

• Willingness to travel worldwide (10–20%)

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

Our purpose.

At Tecan we are driven to improve people’s lives and health. We do this by empowering our customers to scale healthcare innovation globally from life science to the clinic. We collaborate with our customers from early-stage innovation through project implementation and beyond. We deliver the products, services and solutions that make lab processes and medical procedures precise, reproducible and compliant.

Stay unique and make it count.

Our values - trust, highest standards and ambition - are the cornerstones of our business and provide the framework for Tecan's culture. We foster a positive and empowering environment where our rarest assets, our unique employees, can grow and bring their passion and talent to work.

responsabilità

Spécialiste de projet junior en RH BP/RH (80 %, période de fixation de 16 mois)

Männedorf, Zürich

En tant que spécialiste des projets des RH subalternes, vous aiderez le chef des partenariats stratégiques avec les RH et l'AC des RH à réaliser les principaux projets des RH et les résultats attendus des partenariats stratégiques. Cette affectation de 16 mois à durée déterminée combine le travail de projet avec les responsabilités des RH généralistes – idéal pour quelqu'un qui travaille de manière structurée, qui prend en main et qui pense aux RH de manière holistique. Il offre un aperçu approfondi du travail stratégique des RH dans une entreprise mondiale des sciences de la vie.

Vos responsabilités

Projets RH et soutien stratégique aux partenaires commerciaux (environ 70 %)

• Contribuer aux projets et initiatives mondiaux et locaux en matière de RH (p. ex. conception organisationnelle, amélioration des processus de RH, soutien au changement)

• Préparer les produits livrables en matière de RH liés aux partenariats stratégiques d'affaires, comme les examens d'affaires, les documents de la mairie, les présentations des RH divisionnaires, les documents de décision et les documents de communication

• Planification et suivi des projets : jalons, registres d'action, risques, rapports de situation

• Préparer et suivre les ateliers, les comités directeurs et les réunions des parties prenantes

• Compiler les KPI RH et l'analyse des personnes (p. ex., les grades de remplissage, l'attrition, les résultats des enquêtes sur les pouls)

Généraliste RH (environ 30%)

• Conseiller et soutenir les gestionnaires hiérarchiques sur les questions de RH opérationnelles tout au long du cycle de vie des employés, en coordination avec les partenaires opérationnels responsables des RH

• Appuyer les processus de recrutement et d'embarquement

• Projets de contrats, d'ententes et de documents RH

• Agir comme interface avec les services de RH, la paie, l'acquisition de talents et les centres d'expertise

Salaire : CHF 80.000

Vos antécédents

Nous ne cherchons pas seulement des compétences difficiles: Nous recherchons des gens qui apportent leur passion et leur talent au travail.

• Études complétées en RH (p. ex. diplôme fédéral suisse en RH, diplôme CAS/Bachelor en RH ou en administration des affaires)

• 3 à 5 ans d'expérience en tant que généraliste des RH, idéalement dans un environnement international organisé par matrice

• Expérience de la contribution ou de la direction de projets de RH

• Fortes compétences PowerPoint et Excel; travail confiant avec les systèmes de RH (p. ex., SAP SuccessFactors, Workday)

• Intérêt fort de pousser l'IA pour l'utilisation des RH

• Bonne connaissance du droit suisse de l'emploi; intérêt pour les questions de RH internationales

• Excellent écrit et parlé anglais et allemand

• Mode de travail structuré, indépendant et axé sur le service avec un haut niveau de discrétion

• Disponible à bref délai ou dans un délai raisonnable pour une affectation de 16 mois

Ce qui vous sépare

• Vous gardez l'aperçu même avec des projets parallèles et des délais serrés

• Vous combinez une mentalité pratique avec une pensée conceptuelle

• La discrétion et la sensibilité dans le traitement de sujets confidentiels viennent naturellement à vous

Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Product Management team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Associate Product Manager (100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

As an Associate Product Manager, you’ll work closely with our Product Management team to support one of Tecan’s Liquid Handling platforms. This is a great opportunity to learn, grow, and make a real impact—even if you’re just starting out. We’re looking for someone who is eager, honest, and ready to go the extra mile.

Responsibilities

• Support market research and help gather insights about customer needs

• Work closely with your team and other departments to achieve shared goals

• Help promote Tecan products and initiatives

• Assist in developing strategies and marketing plans for our products

• Take ownership of assigned tasks and deliver them on time

• Track product performance and help with pricing analysis

• Support the product life cycle from idea to launch and beyond

• Join product development meetings and contribute your perspective

Your background

We value your attitude and potential as much as your experience. If you’re motivated, open to learning, and ready to take on new challenges, we want to hear from you!

• You have a degree (or are about to graduate) in Chemistry, Biochemistry, Engineering, a technical/scientific field, or similar experience

• You’re independent, can prioritize your work, and are not afraid to ask questions

• You’re a team player who fits well with others and communicates honestly

• You’re a self-starter who is eager to learn

• You’re open, curious, and want to make a difference

• You deliver on your commitments

• You’re comfortable communicating and presenting in English (German or other languages are a plus)

• Experience in sales, marketing, or the life sciences is helpful but not required

• Experience with laboratory automation and liquid handling platforms is a plus

• Ability to travel for work

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Make a real impact on the world of tomorrow

• Work in an international, diverse, and supportive environment

• Grow your career with us—your development matters

• Be empowered by our strong company culture

• Enjoy a comprehensive compensation and benefits package

jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our IT team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Head of Information Security (100%)

Männedorf, Zürich or Barcelona, Spain

Your contribution

As Head of Information Security, you will lead and develop Tecan’s IT (Cyber) Security domain, ensuring robust protection against internal and external threats. You’ll drive the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of IT security strategies, guidelines, and solutions. Collaborating across the business, you’ll define and govern IT security measures, support all IT teams, and partner with external stakeholders.

Responsibilities

• Define, own and continuously evolve Tecan's global Information Security and Cyber Security strategy aligned with business objectives.

• Lead and develop the Information Security organization, including people leadership, budgeting, vendor management and capability development.

• Own the corporate Information Security Management System (ISMS) and maintain ISO 27001 certification across the organization.

• Establish enterprise-wide cyber risk management, security governance, policies, standards and security metrics.

• Advise the CIO, executive leadership and senior stakeholders on cyber risks, security strategy and regulatory requirements.

• Drive security architecture and ensure security-by-design across infrastructure, cloud platforms, applications and digital transformation initiatives.

• Oversee Security Operations, Threat Detection, Incident Response, Vulnerability Management and Cyber Resilience capabilities.

• Own Identity & Access Management, Privileged Access Management and Zero Trust initiatives.

• Ensure compliance with applicable regulations and standards (ISO 27001, NIS2, GDPR, CRA and industry requirements).

• Define the security roadmap and investment portfolio while balancing business enablement and cyber risk.

• Manage strategic relationships with external partners, auditors and security service providers.

• Promote a strong security culture through awareness, governance and executive engagement.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security or related field.

• 10+ years of Information Security experience, including leadership responsibilities.

• Proven experience leading enterprise Information Security organizations within an international environment.

• Demonstrated experience establishing and operating ISO 27001 certified Information Security Management Systems (ISMS).

• Strong understanding of enterprise cyber risk management and governance.

• Experience presenting security strategy and risk to executive management and Boards.

• Deep knowledge of cloud security (Microsoft Azure, Microsoft 365), Identity & Access Management and Zero Trust architectures.

• Experience managing Security Operations, Incident Response and Cyber Crisis Management.

• Familiarity with regulatory frameworks including ISO 27001, NIS2, GDPR, CIS Controls, NIST CSF and Cyber Resilience Act (CRA).

• Strong leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills.

• Professional certifications such as CISSP, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Implementer or Lead Auditor, CRISC are highly desirable.

• Fluent English required; German is an advantage.

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Robotics team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Senior Embedded Software Engineer (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

As a Senior Embedded Software Engineer, you will design, implement, and test embedded software modules and solutions for liquid handling and robotic applications. You will be involved in planning and developing software concepts, ensuring software quality, and troubleshooting. Your role will require interdisciplinary cooperation with electronics, software, and mechanics teams.

Responsibilities

• Plan, develop, and implement software concepts using modern C++ for embedded systems.

• Ensure software quality by applying latest tools and through systematic testing and error correction.

• Collaborate with interdisciplinary teams to integrate software

• Evaluate new tools and methods and define coding standards and guidelines.

• Ensure compliance with processes, SOPs, and regulatory standards (IEC 62304, ISO 13485).

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical discipline (e.g. Mechatronics, Computer Science, Electrical Engineering)

• Strong passion for embedded software engineering

• At least 5 years of professional experience with state-of-the-art software development using modern C++, preferably C++20

• Experience with advanced template metaprogramming

• Experience working with real-time operating systems (RTOS), preferably POSIX-based operating systems

• Experience with communication interfaces and protocols such as SPI, CAN and QUIC and Ethernet-based protocols (e.g. UDP)

• Familiarity with technologies and tools such as Protobuf, CMake, Tracealyzer and Docker is a plus

• Experience in sensing technologies and motor control systems is a plus

jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our R&D team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Senior Motion Control Engineer (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

In this challenging and impactful role, you will be at the forefront of designing, implementing, and testing advanced drive chain concepts and sensing applications for existing- and our next-generation robotic and automation platforms. You will lead the evaluation, collaborate closely with the embedded software, mechanical and electrical specialists, and ensure the performance, reliability, and robustness of our solutions. As a technical mentor and coach, you will support and guide other engineers, contribute to cross-project consistency, and drive continuous improvement in our processes and best practices. Your expertise will help shape the future of healthcare innovation.

• Lead drive concept evaluation, including different actor and sensor types, transmission, and initialization procedures

• Perform motor dimensioning, work point calculation, and simulation

• Review and refine robotic and automation concepts

• Collaborate with mechanical, electrical, and software/system architects

• Develop and improve internal control tools and processes

• Lead root cause investigations and risk assessments

• Mentor and coach engineers, apprentices, trainees, and students

• Initiate collaborations with academia and external partners

• Ensure compliance with processes, SOPs, directives, and guidelines

• Contribute to the system-wide platform strategy

Il tuo contributo

In questo ruolo versatile, assumerai la responsabilità tecnica di un portafoglio di prodotti durante la gestione del ciclo di vita. Con la vostra comprensione tecnica e la passione per i sistemi complessi e la spinta per un costante miglioramento, contribuite in modo significativo a garantire che i nostri prodotti soddisfino sempre i più elevati requisiti del cliente. Essi servono come interfaccia tra produzione interna / esterna, ricerca e sviluppo, approvvigionamento, gestione del prodotto e garanzia di qualità.

• Definizione e sviluppo dei processi MES (Manufacturing Execution System)

• Responsabilità per la gestione dei progetti e dei sottoprogetti in complesse implementazioni e rollout MES

• Supporto tecnico dei prodotti assegnati dal rilascio della serie zero al phase-out.

• Iniziazione e implementazione di cambiamenti meccanici, elettronici o software insieme a un team di esperti.

• Pianificazione e gestione delle validazioni di processo nella nostra produzione o nei fornitori.

• Partecipazione a progetti LCM per la realizzazione degli aspetti produttivi

• Sostegno all'assicurazione della qualità in materia tecnica

• Sostenere l'acquisto con problemi tecnici e attività con fornitori e subfornitori

Il tuo profilo

• Motivazione e responsabilità personale per migliorare continuamente i nostri prodotti e processi produttivi.

• Ingegneria (ingegneria elettrica, ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria dei sistemi o ingegneria di produzione) o tecnico con almeno 5 anni di esperienza professionale

• Ottima conoscenza dell'ingegneria di produzione, progettazione e logistica

• Esperienza professionale nel settore della tecnologia medica regolamentata/biofarmacia, automazione, automotive e/o aviazione

• Molto buona conoscenza del tedesco e dell'inglese in parola e scrittura

• Oltre alle competenze tecniche, stiamo anche cercando una personalità che si distingue per l'azione proattiva e la voglia di un costante miglioramento.

Cosa rende il lavoro a Tecan unico?

· L'opportunità di fare la differenza e modellare il mondo di domani

· Lavorare in un ambiente internazionale e diversificato

· Eccitanti opportunità di carriera

· Cultura aziendale forte e unica

· Compensazione attraente e benefici sociali

Diventa parte di Tecan, certificato come Grande Luogo di Lavoro! Qui potete scoprire di più sulla nostra certificazione. Ottimo posto per lavorare.

Attendiamo con ansia la vostra applicazione online. Per la vostra applicazione, abbiamo solo bisogno del vostro CV (senza foto e senza lettere di motivazione, certificati e diplomi sono facoltativi).

Possiamo solo considerare le applicazioni che soddisfano le nostre esigenze.

Il nostro scopo.

A Tecan siamo spinti a migliorare la vita e la salute delle persone. Lo facciamo dando ai nostri clienti la possibilità di scalare l'innovazione sanitaria a livello globale dalla scienza della vita alla clinica. Collaboriamo con i nostri clienti dall'innovazione del primo stadio attraverso l'implementazione del progetto e oltre. Forniamo prodotti, servizi e soluzioni che rendono i processi di laboratorio e le procedure mediche precise, riproducibili e conformi.

Rimanete unici e fatelo contare.

I nostri valori - la fiducia, i più alti standard e l'ambizione - sono le basi della nostra attività e forniscono il quadro per la cultura di Tecan. Promuoviamo un ambiente positivo e potente in cui i nostri beni più rari, i nostri dipendenti unici, possono crescere e portare la loro passione e talento a lavorare.

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire de la conformité environnementale des produits

jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our EHS Office team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Product Environmental Compliance Manager (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

In this important and hands-on role, you will be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for product environmental compliance at Tecan, responsible for ensuring global compliance with all relevant product environmental and sustainability regulations. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will operationally execute compliance processes and lead multiple complex regulatory projects across various Tecan sites. Your expertise will help shape Tecan’s approach to regulated substances in articles, extended producer responsibility, and the implementation of effective compliance strategies, all within a dynamic environment where regulatory developments are proactively monitored and integrated into our compliance efforts.

Responsibilities

• Execute Tecan’s global SOPs for compliance with regulated substances in articles and extend producer responsibility (RoHS, REACH, POP, TSCA, Conflict Minerals, WEEE, batteries, packaging) including collection of supplier declarations and preparation of compliance documentation

• Lead and implement multiple complex regulatory projects, ensuring efficient prioritization and execution (e.g. RoHS 6b, PFAS)

• Manage the global product environmental compliance database, including compliance software and data maintenance.

• Secure compliance with local extended producer responsibility obligations (WEEE, packaging, batteries), including registrations and reporting.

• Contribute to surveillance and analysis of the global regulatory landscape, supporting the development of long-term compliance strategies.

• Support technical evaluation of new regulations, early risk identification, and design of mitigation strategies.

• Act as a subject matter expert for senior leaders and cross-functional teams, answering internal and external queries.

• Provide training on product environmental compliance topics and perform internal/intra-company audits.

• Maintain clear compliance status reporting and coordinate issuing of compliance certificates and Critical Mineral reporting.

• Possibility to represent Tecan in trade associations, ensuring alignment with industry standards.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Higher education degree in a scientific or engineering discipline; chemical background is a plus.

• 5+ years of experience in product stewardship or product environmental regulations, preferably in MedTech.

• Experience implementing complex product environmental requirements.

• Familiarity with product environmental regulations and standards (RoHS, REACH, POP, PFAS, WEEE, Batteries, Packaging).

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and German.

• Strong communicator able to explain the “why” behind regulations to diverse audiences.

• Project management experience in a matrix organization.

• Experience in material management, especially SAP.

• Pragmatic, solution-driven working style with a sense of urgency and a strong track record of meeting deadlines.

• Ability to prioritise effectively.

• Willingness to travel internationally (<10%).

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).

descriptionByLocale.en:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our EHS Office team and bring your passion and talent to work.

Product Environmental Compliance Manager (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

In this important and hands-on role, you will be the Subject Matter Expert (SME) for product environmental compliance at Tecan, responsible for ensuring global compliance with all relevant product environmental and sustainability regulations. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will operationally execute compliance processes and lead multiple complex regulatory projects across various Tecan sites. Your expertise will help shape Tecan’s approach to regulated substances in articles, extended producer responsibility, and the implementation of effective compliance strategies, all within a dynamic environment where regulatory developments are proactively monitored and integrated into our compliance efforts.

Responsibilities

• Execute Tecan’s global SOPs for compliance with regulated substances in articles and extend producer responsibility (RoHS, REACH, POP, TSCA, Conflict Minerals, WEEE, batteries, packaging) including collection of supplier declarations and preparation of compliance documentation

• Lead and implement multiple complex regulatory projects, ensuring efficient prioritization and execution (e.g. RoHS 6b, PFAS)

• Manage the global product environmental compliance database, including compliance software and data maintenance.

• Secure compliance with local extended producer responsibility obligations (WEEE, packaging, batteries), including registrations and reporting.

• Contribute to surveillance and analysis of the global regulatory landscape, supporting the development of long-term compliance strategies.

• Support technical evaluation of new regulations, early risk identification, and design of mitigation strategies.

• Act as a subject matter expert for senior leaders and cross-functional teams, answering internal and external queries.

• Provide training on product environmental compliance topics and perform internal/intra-company audits.

• Maintain clear compliance status reporting and coordinate issuing of compliance certificates and Critical Mineral reporting.

• Possibility to represent Tecan in trade associations, ensuring alignment with industry standards.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• Higher education degree in a scientific or engineering discipline; chemical background is a plus.

• 5+ years of experience in product stewardship or product environmental regulations, preferably in MedTech.

• Experience implementing complex product environmental requirements.

• Familiarity with product environmental regulations and standards (RoHS, REACH, POP, PFAS, WEEE, Batteries, Packaging).

• Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English and German.

• Strong communicator able to explain the “why” behind regulations to diverse audiences.

• Project management experience in a matrix organization.

• Experience in material management, especially SAP.

• Pragmatic, solution-driven working style with a sense of urgency and a strong track record of meeting deadlines.

• Ability to prioritise effectively.

• Willingness to travel internationally (<10%).

W hat makes working at Tecan unique

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• The chance to grow your career within the company

• Feel empowered by our strong and unique company culture

• Comprehensive compensation and benefits package

Join Tecan, a great place to work! Read about our recent certification from Great Place to Work .

We’re looking forward to receiving your application online. Please submit your CV or resume (w/o picture and w/o cover letter, reference letters and diplomas are optional).
