jobs.description:
Ever wondered how your skills and unique background could impact the world of tomorrow? Join our Product Development team and bring your passion and talent to work.

CAD / PDM Administrator (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zürich

Your contribution

Are you passionate about making a difference in how teams work with cutting-edge CAD and PDM systems? At Tecan, you’ll play a key role in supporting innovation and efficiency across our global organization.

Responsibilities

• You’ll drive the development and improvement of our internal processes, tools, and best practices, collaborating with stakeholders from all Tecan sites.

• You’ll ensure our CAD and PDM systems are always available, up-to-date, and running smoothly, working closely with our IT department.

• You’ll support your colleagues by providing first-level support, sharing your expertise, and helping them get the most out of our systems.

• You’ll test new application versions, prepare and support upgrades, and collect user feedback to make our tools even better.

• You’ll create and update user documentation and training materials, and you’ll organize and lead engaging training sessions.

• You’ll act as a technical lead for CAD power users and as a local SAP Power User.

Your background

We’re not just looking for hard skills: We’re looking for people who bring their passion and talent to work.

• You have a background in Mechanical Engineering

• You have more than 5 years of experience with PTC and Creo and brings experience in Windchill administration

• You have basic experience as an SAP user and have advanced IT knowledge in both hardware and software

• You’re familiar with scripting and basic programming

• You communicate fluently in both German and English, written and spoken

• You’re detail-oriented, organized, and able to prioritize in a fast-paced environment.

• You enjoy working independently, are proactive, and can be relied upon by your team.

• You’re a great communicator, able to explain technical topics to both technical and non-technical colleagues.

The chance to make it count and to have an impact on the world of tomorrow

Have you ever wondered how your skills and unique background can affect the world of tomorrow? Become a part of our Labwerx and use the talent and passion that makes you.

Custom Assembly, Logistics & Integration Specialist Labwerx (80-100%)

Männedorf, Zurich

Your contribution

Take responsibility for our logistics and assembly processes! You are at the heart of our production – from incoming goods and carefully checking goods, to booking in SAP, assembling mechanical components, to preparing materials for projects and shipping. With your commitment, you ensure that our projects run smoothly and our teams are optimally equipped.

• Receiving goods and carefully checking incoming goods

• Recording incoming goods in SAP

• Assign and organize materials to the respective projects so that everything is in the right place at the right time

• Precisely and carefully assemble mechanical components

• Provide production and project teams with the required materials quickly and reliably

• Package goods for shipping and pay attention to every detail

• Support project deliveries through efficient assembly and packaging

• Perform the annual inventory and keep stock up-to-date

• Ensure bulk materials are always available to avoid production delays

Your profile

We are not just looking for expertise, but people who want to bring their passion and talent to us.

• Completed vocational training in logistics, warehouses, production or mechanics

• Experience in warehouse logistics, goods receipt or assembly

• Good knowledge of mechanical assembly, tool handling and material management

• Basic computer skills and willingness to learn new systems (experience with SAP or other ERP systems is beneficial)

• Physical load capacity for lifting and moving materials

• Strong team spirit, reliability and a structured, careful working method

• Very good knowledge of German; English skills are beneficial

What makes working at Tecan unique?

• The opportunity to make a difference and shape the world of tomorrow

• Working in an international and diverse environment

• Exciting career opportunities

• Attractive remuneration and benefits

We can only consider applications that meet our requirements.

Hast du dich jemals gefragt, wie deine Fähigkeiten und dein einzigartiger Hintergrund die Welt von morgen beeinflussen kann? Werde ein Teil unseres EHS / FM Teams und setze das Talent und die Leidenschaft, die dich ausmachen, bei uns ein.

EHS-Spezialist / Sicherheitsbeauftragter 80-100%

Männedorf & Nänikon

Dein Beitrag
Für unseren Standorte in der Schweiz suchen wir eine engagierte und kompetente Persönlichkeit als EHS-Spezialist / Sicherheitsbeauftragten. In dieser vielseitigen Funktion übernimmst du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Umsetzung und kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung unserer EHS Environment-, Health- & Safety-Organisation, des EHS-Managementsystems (ISO 14001 und 45001) sowie den Prozessen und trägst dazu bei, einen sicheren, gesunden und nachhaltigen Arbeitsplatz zu schaffen.

• Verantwortung bzw. Koordination zu Arbeitssicherheit, Gesundheitsschutz, Gefahrstoffe, Umwelt und Notfallorganisation

• Verantwortung für die Weiterentwicklung des EHS-Managementsystems (ISO 14001 / ISO 45001) unter Einhaltung von Konzernvorgaben und gesetzlichen Anforderungen.

• Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von gesetzlichen, behördlichen und internen Anforderungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit den Behörden, Fachstellen und Dienstleistern

• Beratung, Unterstützung und Schulung der Standortleitung, der Führungskräfte sowie der Mitarbeitenden in allen EHS-Bereichen

• Durchführung und Koordination von Gefährdungsbeurteilungen, Risikoanalysen, Audits und Sicherheitsinspektionen

• Analyse von Unfällen, Ereignissen und Beinaheunfällen sowie Definition und Nachverfolgung von Verbesserungsmassnahmen

• Erarbeitung und Monitoring von EHS-Kennzahlen und Management-Reports

Dein Profil
Wir sind nicht nur auf der Suche nach Fachwissen: Wir suchen nach Menschen, die ihre Leidenschaft und ihr Talent bei uns umsetzen.

• Technische oder naturwissenschaftliche Ausbildung mit Weiterbildung sowie die Qualifikation als Spezialist ASGS oder Expert ASGS

• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im Bereich EHS / Arbeitssicherheit, idealerweise in einem Industrieunternehmen

• Fundierte Erfahrung im Aufbau, der Weiterentwicklung und Auditierung von Managementsystemen nach ISO 14001 und ISO 45001

• Qualifikationen als Sicherheitsbeauftragter Brandschutz, Chemikalienansprechperson und Gefahrgutbeauftragter

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse der schweizerischen Gesetzgebungen und Anwendungen

• Selbstständige, strukturierte und lösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise

• Durchsetzungsvermögen und gleichzeitig ausgeprägte Beratungs- und Kommunikationskompetenz

• Hohe Eigenverantwortung und Resilienz kombiniert mit einer pragmatischen und lösungsorientierten Arbeitsweise.

• Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Was macht die Arbeit bei Tecan einzigartig?

• Eine verantwortungsvolle und vielseitige Schlüsselposition mit direktem Einfluss auf die Sicherheit und Nachhaltigkeit unseres Standortes

• Die Möglichkeit, EHS-Prozesse und die Sicherheitskultur aktiv mitzugestalten und weiterzuentwickeln

• Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Standortleitung und den verschiedenen Fachbereichen

• Hohe Eigenverantwortung und viel Gestaltungsspielraum

• Ein abwechslungsreiches Umfeld in einem internationalen Industrieunternehmen

• Die Chance, etwas zu bewirken und die Welt von morgen mitzugestalten

• Spannende Karrieremöglichkeiten

• Starke und einzigartige Unternehmenskultur

• Attraktive Vergütung und Sozialleistungen

Werde ein Teil von Tecan, zertifiziert als Great Place to Work! Hier kannst du mehr über unsere Zertifizierung erfahren. Great Place to Work.

jobs.description:
Field Automation Engineer

Full-Time
Bay Area, CA | Up to 60% Travel

Make an Impact With Our Team

Are you passionate about laboratory automation, technical problem-solving, and helping customers get the most from their scientific instrumentation? We are seeking a Field Automation Engineer to provide field-based technical support for Tecan Detection instruments.

In this role, you will serve as a customer-facing technical resource responsible for instrument installation, service, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, application development and implementation, customer training, and technical demonstrations. You will work closely with customers, Sales, Field Automation Engineers, and internal technical teams to ensure successful instrument implementation, reliable performance, and customer satisfaction.

You will provide hands-on technical expertise throughout the customer lifecycle, from installation and application support through ongoing service, troubleshooting, training, and customer follow-up.

If you enjoy solving complex technical challenges, working directly with customers, and supporting innovative laboratory technologies, we encourage you to apply.

How Will You Make an Impact?

• Perform installation and implementation of Tecan Detection instruments at customer sites.

• Diagnose, troubleshoot, service, and perform preventive maintenance on Tecan Detection instruments.

• Support application development, implementation, and troubleshooting to help customers achieve their laboratory objectives.

• Provide customer training on instrument operation, applications, maintenance, and troubleshooting.

• Perform complex instrument demonstrations and support Sales activities as a technical resource.

• Provide technical support and solutions that build customer confidence and strengthen the company's service reputation.

• Partner closely with customers, Sales, Field Automation Engineers, and internal technical teams to identify issues and deliver effective solutions.

• Share information obtained from unique technical challenges, customer situations, and specialized training with the Field Automation team and broader Tecan organization.

• Maintain accurate and complete service records in accordance with company policies and procedures.

• Maintain appropriate parts inventory by monitoring stock levels, anticipating requirements, and coordinating the ordering and receipt of needed supplies.

• Provide backup service support outside the assigned territory as needed to support customer service objectives.

• Maintain technical knowledge through manufacturer training, educational workshops, technical publications, and continuous learning.

• Maintain strong customer communication and follow-up throughout service and application activities.

• Travel regularly to customer sites and maintain flexibility to support short-notice assignments when required.

• Follow all applicable company safety procedures, OSHA requirements, and state and federal regulations, and promptly report safety concerns.

• Complete assigned responsibilities in a timely manner and respond productively to changing business and customer needs.

What You Bring

• Strong customer-focused communication and relationship-building skills.

• Excellent written, verbal, and technical communication abilities.

• Strong analytical thinking and troubleshooting capabilities.

• Ability to work effectively under pressure and manage multiple priorities.

• Strong organizational, time-management, and follow-up skills.

• High level of initiative, accountability, professionalism, and dependability.

• Ability to work independently while contributing effectively as part of a team.

• Ability to interact effectively with diverse groups both inside and outside the organization.

• Strong customer service orientation and ability to establish positive working relationships with customers.

• Willingness to share technical knowledge and new information with team members.

• Professional phone and customer communication skills.

• Ability and willingness to travel up to 60% , including regional travel and occasional short-notice assignments.

• Valid driver's license required.

Your Background

• Bachelor's degree in Life Science, Computer Science, Biomedical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or equivalent industry experience.

• Minimum of 3 years of laboratory, scientific instrumentation, automation, or related technical experience .

• Experience supporting laboratory instrumentation, automation systems, or scientific equipment in academic, clinical, or industry environments.

• Hands-on experience with instrument installation, preventive maintenance, troubleshooting, repair, or field service activities.

• Electromechanical experience preferred.

• Experience supporting customers in technical or scientific environments.

• Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Windows and Microsoft Office applications.

• Ability to interpret technical documentation, service procedures, and instrument specifications.

Nice to Have

• Experience with Tecan Detection instruments or other laboratory detection platforms.

• Experience with laboratory automation and scientific instrumentation.

• Experience in application development or implementation.

• Experience delivering customer training and technical demonstrations.

• Experience supporting Sales teams as a technical resource.

• Experience troubleshooting instrument software, hardware, and application-related issues.

• Knowledge of laboratory workflows and life science applications.

• Experience collaborating with Engineering, Applications, Quality, Regulatory, Operations, and Sales teams.

What We Offer

• Competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits package.

• Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance.

• 401(k) with company match.

• Paid time off and company holidays.

• Professional development and technical training opportunities.

• Career growth within a global leader in laboratory automation.

• Collaborative and innovative team environment.
